governance.note: Keeper-track candidate on the PROMOTED ercot59-storage-deploy recipe, ONE structural delta: ercot_gas_commitment_bridge=True — the P1-native gas-CC committed-state bridge (the ISO-neutral CAISO RA-mustoffer internals behind an own ERCOT gate; state detected from the model's OWN base-cost P0 run pattern; physical <min-down restart bar + economic ≥min-down bridging on the startup-restart inequality priced at the model's own P0 duals, bounded to one DA operating day). DOF LEDGER (rule 20) — every parameter with its identification source, ZERO fitted to any residual: (1) ercot_gas_bridge_min_load_frac = 0.574 — the MEASURED ERCOT committed-CC LSL/HSL capacity-weighted p50, 60-Day DAM disclosure Gen Resource data 2023-2025 (ERCOT-62 derive, diagnosis §5); in practice the floor clips at each plant's committed-tranche capacity (median committed share 25%), so the value is a measured ceiling, not a tuning surface. (2) min-down / startup costs — the unit's own CAMPD-bin physics or the published NREL/SR-5500-55433 class tables (the same _ra_bridge_unit_params the CAISO keeper uses; rule 18 physics gating). (3) DA_COMMITMENT_HORIZON_HOURS = 24 — tariff-cited one-operating-day DAM commitment horizon (constants.py); the nohorizon probe rung measured the cap near-costless (35 gaps >24h exist; uncapping moves <±0.1 on every metric). (4) run_threshold_frac = 0.05 — the pre-existing shared run detector default, untouched. CLASS ADJUDICATION recorded at the ScenarioConfig field: CC-only (CT physics-inert per rule 18 + measured committed band ≈ model; ST_GAS rule-19-excluded — its committed state is the drag floor's). The CAISO startup-aware screen is NOT exposed (dropped with cause: it prices anchors off the model's own trough duals — the exact +$5-7-overpriced quantity under repair — and refuses every anchor; re-thresholding it would be a residual-fitted knob, rules 13/20; the phantom-micro-run mode it guards is bounded by the measured gap distribution instead: p10/p50/p90 = 2/6/14h, 0 gaps >24h). 2023 probe ladder vs the byte-faithful keeper reconstruction (diagnosis §7): the bridge ALONE moves every storage/spread circle target the right way — median daily spread 13.5→14.9 ($), viable-arbitrage days 81→85, trough h<$15 101→228, storage throughput 0.65→0.74 TWh, HE18/19 discharge 205/437→243/505 MW, C3a +3.9→+3.1%, C3b 0.133→0.131, C3c and slack byte-stable — while the coal shift (-1.37 TWh) moves coal TOWARD its measured actual (keeper coal was +5.4 TWh over; CC_REGULAR lands within 0.1 TWh of actual). Composing ercot_offer_surface_lowcurve back on re-instates its §5 spread-compression signature, so the markdown stays default-off (rule 1: no right number through a wrong mechanism). On the full 2023-2025 bundle: C1/C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C5a/C7/C8 PASS; the keeper's own C5c-2024 storage-shape ledgered FAIL (r=0.329) now PASSES — the mechanism's design axis (storage cycling against a real daily spread) is exactly what C5c measures; C3c-2024 inherited unchanged (27h, byte-identical — this mechanism prices troughs, not the scarcity tail). C3a-2024/2025 drift -4.6→-6.4% / -1.1→-3.0% (both inside the ±10% gate every year): the honest signature of a trough-deepening mechanism on years whose level bias is already negative — reported, not buried (rule 11). LOYO note (rule 22): the mechanism carries ZERO year-fitted parameters (every input is measured physics/market design or the model's own solution), so leave-one-year-out reduces to per-year stability: the bridge fires condition-responsively in every year (7.91 / 9.56 / 8.15 TWh floor volume 2023/2024/2025, 0 gaps >24h in all years) and no gate flips in any single year. No offer curve, sigmoid, floor, or ORDC parameter touched (rule 26).
